newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-WMC tight-lipped on bid plan for CVRD.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-WMC tight-lipped on bid plan for CVRD.

text.p: Australian miner WMC Ltd was tight lipped on Monday about a report it was considering a consortium with Japan's Mitsui Group and Brazil's MBR to bid for a stake in Brazil's state-owned miner, CVRD.

A WMC spokeswoman said the company was in talks with several parties and was studying data on the Brazilian mining giant, but declined to confirm Mitsui and iron ore miner MBR were potential partners in a bid for a slice of CVRD.
"We have not reached the stage of making a decision and we are in talks with several parties," spokeswoman Tricia Wunsch told Reuters in Melbourne.
"All we have said is that we have confirmed we are interested in Brazil and looking at the possibility of entering a consortium to bid for the portion of CVRD that's up for sale."
Last week, a Brazilian news agency quoted visiting WMC chief executive Hugh Morgan as saying he was looking to form a bid consortium with Mitsui and Mineracoes Brasileiras Reunidas (MBR).

A 45 percent block of CVRD voting shares was being auctioned for a minimum price of three billion reais (US$2.83 billion) on April 29 in the first stage of the company's privatisation. A staff and global offer will complete the privatisation process.
